rules.title: King County algorithmic rent-pricing chapter: renter remedies
rules.requirement: Under the county's algorithmic rent-pricing chapter, injured renters may seek actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation, and attorney fees.
rules.key_value: Up to $7,500 per violation, plus actual damages and attorney fees

coverage.summary: The source states no building, unit-count or landlord-size coverage limits.

rules.effective_date_note: The only source gives 'effective October 2025' (month only), so no exact day is available. The law is treated as in force as of the 2026-10-01 query date.
rules.quoted_span: Injured renters may seek actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation and attorney fees.
rules.review_note: Supported only by a secondary law-firm alert (Morgan Lewis, Aug. 21, 2026), which describes only the remedy. The source does not state the prohibited conduct, covered software, section-level citation, ordinance number, exact effective date or geographic reach (countywide vs. unincorporated areas). Verify all of these against the King County Code text.
